item.title: Hungary's 'Hollywood on the Danube' faces Trump tariff threat
item.description: A prop axe was brought in as crew members set the scene for a horror movie being filmed in Budapest's former psychiatric institute, one of numerous Hollywood productions under way in the Hungarian capital.

item.title: Electric vehicle prowess helps China's flying car sector take off
item.description: A worker in white gloves inspects the propellers of a boxy two-seater aircraft fresh off the assembly line at a Chinese factory trialling the mass production of flying cars. The lightweight six-propeller aircraft under construction take off vertically and fit into a large car, to create the "Land Aircraft Carrier" -- a modular flying vehicle made by Aridge, an arm of Chinese EV maker XPeng.

item.title: Nigeria to host Africa International Defence Exhibition in 2026
item.description: Nigeria will host the inaugural Africa International Defence Exhibition from 26–29 October 2026, reflecting the continent’s expanding defence and security landscape.

item.title: Unforgettable: 6 times the Super Eagles delivered magic at the AFCON
item.description: Nigeria are three-time champions of the Africa Cup of Nations, but six moments have been picked as the Super Eagles' most memorable in the competition's history.

item.title: President Tinubu meets Jonathan at Aso Rock, photo, video surface
item.description: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has met with one of his predecessors, Goodluck Ebele Jonathan, at Aso Rock, Abuja. A photo of the meeting has surfaced.

item.title: "U dey glow differently": Mohbad's dad steps out in style amid fight with Wunmi
item.description: Late singer Mohbad’s father, Joseph Aloba, appeared in a viral video singing in a black suit amid his legal battle with Wunmi over the singer’s estate.

item.title: Victor Osimhen: Why striker snubbed the Premier League to sign for Galatasaray
item.description: Victor Osimhen has revealed why he chose to sign for Galatasaray over Premier League giants, despite interest from Chelsea, Arsenal, and Manchester United.

item.title: Bandits strike again in Kwara state, kidnap top monarch
item.description: Oba Kamilu Salami has been abducted by bandits in Kwara, sparking fear and tension across the community. Nigerian media outlets reported the attack.

item.title: Breaking: Tinubu appoints 32 new ambassadors, full list emerges
item.description: President Bola Tinubu nominates 32 ambassadors for Senate approval, including high-profile non-career nominees like Reno Omokri and Femi Fani-Kayode.

item.title: Thousands of jobs created as Dangote Refinery saves Nigeria N10bn every year
item.description: Dangote Petroleum Refinery is saving Nigeria over N10 billion annually in Forex by contributing to reduced import bills and improved economic stability.
